text: Once we returned to Melromarc, we hurried straight to the castle. Upon entering, the queen was waiting for us. We were immediately escorted to the operations command center.
“Lord Iwatani, welcome back. I have something to discuss…”
“I know. It’s about the Phoenix’s seal being broken, not the Spirit Tortoise’s, right?”
The queen nodded at Father’s reply. It seems information about the Phoenix has already reached us. I’m glad we can get straight to the point.
“It appears Ren and Itsuki caught us off guard and headed that way.”
“Since our attention was focused on the Land of the Spirit Tortoise, this incident will likely cause some delays in mobilizing the military.”

“Yeah. But… considering the scale of the enemy, I want to rely on the Hero’s power to handle this as much as possible. According to Motoyasu, I think we’re capable of taking them down simultaneously now.”
“Understood. Then, just to be safe, we’ll assemble a coalition army to fight the Phoenix.”
“Please do. Also, I’d like to ask you to rescue anyone who might be in danger from the Phoenix.”
Spreading a map out on the desk, the Queen explained to us the Phoenix’s current movements.
“Currently, the information we’re receiving is conflicting. However, one confirmed fact is that the country where the Phoenix was sealed is now suffering massive damage due to its advance.”
“That’s true… Ideally, we’d like to engage the Phoenix head-on and annihilate it immediately, but…”
“The problem is where the Phoenix is headed, isn’t it?”

I believe the Spirit Tortoise and the Phoenix have similar patterns of behavior. Since the Four Spirits are said to have a tendency to gather the souls of living beings, they’ll likely head for areas densely populated by humans and monsters. In fact, in the first world, the Spirit Tortoise traveled through various countries and was ultimately defeated by my Father upon arriving at the town below Melromarc Castle. The Queen is plotting a predicted path on the map, centered around the country where the Phoenix is sealed.
“Motoyasu, is there anything else you know about the Phoenix?”
“Aside from the danger if we don’t defeat them simultaneously, it’s the way they coordinate—one flying at high altitude and the other at low altitude.”
“For now, our strategy seems to be relying on you, Motoyasu, to take them down…”
“No problem at all.”
After all, I’ve fought them in the first world. I think I can defeat them with ease now. I’ve become even stronger than I was back then, so I’m confident I can avoid the worst-case scenario now.
“By the way, something’s been bothering me—Ren, Itsuki, and I took on the Phoenix, which is far stronger than the Spirit Tortoise, didn’t we?”
“That’s how it turned out, yes.”
“Well, if we barely survived against the Spirit Tortoise… it wouldn’t be surprising if we’d died fighting the Phoenix, right? If that happened, wouldn’t we end up in a loop, like Motoyasu-kun said?”
Now that you mention it, that’s true. But we haven’t entered a loop yet. When we fought the Spirit Tortoise in the first world, Ren, Itsuki, and I all survived.

It’s true we barely escaped with our lives… but come to think of it, the Spirit Tortoise didn’t seem to even notice us. Do the Four Spirits simply ignore the Four Sacred Heroes because they aren’t considered a threat? There’s no other way to explain it.
“Maybe… the Four Spirits understand that they shouldn’t kill Ren or Itsuki?”

Father’s theory isn’t out of the question. Both the Spirit Tortoise and the Phoenix would attack us if it came to a fight, but it’s highly likely they’re acting on some other objective that takes priority over defeating the Heroes.

“For now, we’ll just have to consider this a stroke of luck and press on. Even if we do end up in a loop here, as Motoyasu-kun suggested… Motoyasu-kun, please keep that in mind so we can apply what we learn to the next time.”
“Yes, sir.”
“So, Your Majesty. We’re heading toward the Phoenix—is it okay to go straight there?”
“Regarding that… since there’s some conflicting information, please give me a little time.”
“Then I’ll periodically return to the castle via portal. I’ll ask about the Phoenix’s whereabouts once we’re there.”
“Yes. We’ll make as many preparations as we can on our end.”
After receiving the Phoenix’s predicted movement range from the Queen, we immediately set off at a hurry.

The Phoenix’s sealed land, much like the Spirit Tortoise’s sealed country, is quite far from Melromarc—even for the swift-footed Filolial-sama. As a result, even while we were traveling, reports of damage caused by the Phoenix kept reaching our ears one after another.

We have absolutely no idea what happened to Ren and Itsuki—other than the fact that they’re still alive. I’ve experienced this myself in the first world. If they were simply running away from reality out of guilt for having done something terrible… that would have been for the best, but the worst-case scenarios just keep piling up.

It had been three days since we’d been hopping from one of Filolial-sama’s forms to another. Even though I knew it was reckless to keep them in continuous use, we were making good progress. The Phoenix was advancing rapidly—we’d heard it was moving from west to north—so we were being tossed about by all the unnecessary movements when it happened. A sound like shattering glass rang out… and my Father and I broke out in a cold sweat.
“Ugh… Hey, Motoyasu, there’s something I really don’t want to check right now.”
“I know…”

Even I could tell exactly what my Father was getting at. Judging by the sound, it meant the Hero had just been informed of some terrible event. Trembling with fear, I focused my attention on the hourglass icon in the corner of my screen. Then, another one appeared there… a blue hourglass, displaying the number 7.
“This must be the Spirit Tortoise.”
My father clutched his head and crouched down.
“Surely not… Did either Ren or Itsuki break the Phoenix’s seal, and while we were running around in a panic, the one who remained broke the Spirit Tortoise’s seal instead!?”
“That’s the only way to explain it.”
“Do those two want to hasten the end of the world or something?!”
“I wonder if they made some kind of pact just to outsmart us?”

Knowing those two, it’s not out of the question. But… this hourglass icon looks a little strange. The two icons are depicted as being connected in some way. There’s an ‘=’ at the junction. I don’t recognize this at all. What could it be?

“The Phoenix is troublesome enough on its own, but now we have to take on the Spirit Tortoise too… I hate to say it, but I wish they’d gotten suspicious when the Phoenix still hadn’t been defeated after three days!”

Whether it’s Ren or Itsuki, I don’t know if they didn’t attempt to fight it due to unforeseen circumstances or if they failed, but I wish they’d hesitated before doing something as foolish as breaking the seal. If they’d waited until it was defeated before challenging it, it would’ve been back-to-back battles, but that would’ve been better. Well, looking at the numbers, it’s still better than having the Qilin challenge us.

There’s a sealed area near Faubrey where the Qilin is. Takt is there, after all. There’s a chance Ren or Itsuki could get killed in the chaos. That said, for us right now, it’s like adding insult to injury. The Father looks very troubled.
“Motoyasu, leave the Phoenix to you. Do you think we can handle the Spirit Tortoise on our own?”

The portal location we saved when the Phoenix’s seal was broken is a bit far away. It’ll probably take more than half a day to encounter the Spirit Tortoise once it starts moving. After all, right after its revival, the Spirit Tortoise will attack nearby countries, towns, and monster lairs.
“I think we’ll probably be fine.”

“I see… Well then, Motoyasu, once you find out where the Phoenix is, head over there. Until then, let’s go after the Spirit Tortoise with us. If we can take down the Spirit Tortoise first, that’d be ideal.”
“Understood.”
“Everyone, make sure you’re ready to fight at any moment.”
Everyone in the carriage, Filolial-sama and his companions, and even our Rival all agreed. We used as many portals as we could and teleported there.
Half a day later, we gradually began to see the Spirit Tortoise rampaging through the area.
“According to Motoyasu, we need to destroy both the head and the heart at the same time, right?”
“That’s right.”
“The tricky part is the head’s attacks from the outside. So, Motoyasu and the Filolials, please take care of the heart inside its body. We’ll keep crushing the head from the outside!”
“Are we really going to take on that thing!?”

Keel shouts, his eyes fixed on the Spirit Tortoise. It’s an outrageously huge monster. His reaction is understandable. However, I believe that with our current strength, we’re not without a chance of defeating it.

Well… aside from my Father and me, the rest of us are just faking our stats with aptitude enhancements. Even so, we definitely possess abilities equivalent to at least a 170. With this many people, there’s no doubt we can take on the Spirit Tortoise and win, even with such a small group. We need to take down the Spirit Tortoise quickly and move on to the Phoenix.
“That’s right. Sure, it looks intimidating, but I’m sure we can win.”
